FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Information.

2. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.

3. When practising Listening for Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Vocabulary.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Vocabulary.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Vocabulary.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Vocabulary.

4. When practising Persuasive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Persuasive speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Persuasive speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Persuasive speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Persuasive speaking.

5. When practising Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing.

6. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.

7. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. fenêtre
   B. livre
   C. porte
   D. chaise

8. When practising Oral expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral expression.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Oral expression.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral expression.

9. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Excuse me
   B. Good night only
   C. Thank you
   D. Good morning / hello

10. When practising Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Comprehension.

11. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.

12. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Process Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Creative Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Descriptive Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Imaginative Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Functional Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Vocabulary.

7. B — livre

8. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral expression.

9. D — Good morning / hello

10. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.

11. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
